name: Timotheus
summary: A disciple with a believing Jewish mother and a Greek father, who became Paul's close helper on his travels. Paul sent him to strengthen the churches and called him his dearly beloved son.

key_moments.title: Joining Paul
key_moments.description: In Derbe and Lystra Paul found a disciple named Timotheus, whose mother was a Jewish believer and whose father was a Greek. The believers spoke well of him, and Paul took him along on his travels.

key_moments.title: Sent to Thessalonica
key_moments.description: While Paul waited alone at Athens, he sent Timotheus to strengthen and comfort the Thessalonian believers in their troubles. Timotheus came back with good news of their faith and love.

key_moments.title: Like a Son to Paul
key_moments.description: Paul hoped to send Timotheus to the Philippians soon, saying he had no one else like-minded who truly cared for them. Timotheus had served with Paul in the gospel as a son serves with his father.

key_moments.title: A Faith Passed Down
key_moments.description: Paul wrote to Timothy as his dearly beloved son and remembered him in prayer night and day. He recalled Timothy's sincere faith, which had lived first in his grandmother Lois and his mother Eunice.
